QuestInfo.name: Your Daughter's Hand
QuestInfo.0: Alpha and Beta discovered Lan Ming and Lilishu's relationship while investigating the meat crime at the pharmacy. Looked like Lan Ming had something to say about it.
QuestInfo.1: Proof of strength is needed to get permission from Lilishu's father Mr. Ku. But Lan Ming is still no up to that level. Go take the proof of strength to Mr. Ku for Lan Ming.
QuestInfo.2: Alpha and Beta tried to help, but Mr. Ku saw through it all and became furious. Lan Ming's future looked to be full of trials...

0.0: It's true. Lilishu and I are in love. Our training has made our bond unbreakable. Lilishu is a warmhearted, thoughtful girl.
0.1: It's Mr. Ku, Lilishu's father. Of course, he doesn't know yet, but if he finds out, he'll be so... I get the chills just thinking about it. So can you lend me a hand...?

yes.0: Mr. Ku has been telling everyone he wants Lilishu to marry a strong man. He has to at least be able to take the #rKing Sage Cat#k. But at this point, I'm hopeless.
yes.1: I hear you're pretty strong.... Could you get #r1 #t4033791##k to bring to Mr. Ku? I feel bad for lying, but I have no choice! I'll be forever alone if I don't marry Lilishu!

no.0: I'm never going to get married without your help.

1.0: Lan Ming wants to marry Lilishu?! How dare he even think about taking my beautiful girl!

yes.0: Wait, isn't this #r#t4033791##k? I...had no idea Lan Ming was strong enough to get rid of the King Sage Cat! I can totally allow him to marry my daughter... Or NOT! I know Lan Ming can't even look at the King Sage Cat at his level. Trying to deceive me, huh! I will NEVER allow you to marry my Lilishu!

default.0: Anyone fit to be with Lilishu shall possess both physical and mental fortitude. Of course!

npc.0: Mr. Ku may let me get close to Lilishu if I show him #r1 #t4033791##k.
